integrity: One analytic theorem and sharp boundary witnesses; all public derivations trace to identified source results; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only limit-inferior stationarity under the original outer assumptions; not full-sequence convergence.
Finite termination at nonstationary exact proximal steps only; terminal zero-step handling is separate.
The sharpness witness concerns universal Type-1 descent/FCD certificates, not necessary failure of every algorithm at the endpoint.
title: Sharp observable-error threshold for inexact proximal trust-region Cauchy points
